name: fluent-wp
description: 54 shared native tools and remote tasks for FluentCRM, FluentCommunity and Fluent Forms with private site profiles and cross-plugin snapshots.
long_description: Remote local stdio companion with reviewed native arguments, mandatory local confirmation for mutations/stateful reports/private files, and direct read-only enforcement. Official plugin MCPs and WP-CLI commands are distinct options. Application Password authentication; no browser/session import or automatic retries.

site_url.title: Trusted HTTPS WordPress site root
site_url.description: Your own intended site URL, optionally an install subdirectory. Do not include wp-json, a query or embedded credentials.

username.title: WordPress username
username.description: The intended user with native plugin permissions.

app_password.title: Dedicated Application Password
app_password.description: Sensitive private application password. Choose this or password_file; never the main login password.

password_file.title: Private application-password file
password_file.description: Absolute owner-private non-symlink file outside repositories. Use instead of inline app_password; restrict Windows ACLs.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse mutations, stateful Forms report and file writes.
